messages:
Alex: quick idea 3: small /pin-nudge command on deploy bot to quickly move traffic to a known good revision. goal: reduce manual steps during incidents.

Rina: must-haves?

Alex: dry-run preview, validate target exists, open ops PR stub, TTL (default 60m) that auto-unpins, and an explicit undo (/pin-unwind <pr>).

Carlos: change-window safety: if inside window require oncall ack or 2 approvals. bot can check calendar flag.

Alex: bot should also watch basic signals during TTL (cpu, p95, 5xx) and post a short status. if regressions, create a revert suggestion and a 2-person poll.

OpsBot: I will create PR in ops/rollpointer with the pin change. dry-run shows command: `deployctl pin svc rev --source=pin-nudge-bot --note="..."`.

Rina: small tmux helper for responders would help. prototype script: `tmux new -d -s pin-$svc "stern -n 200 /var/log/$svc/*" ; splitw -v "watch -n 10 deployctl status $svc" ; splitw -h "watch -n 5 kubectl get pods -l app=$svc"`

Alex: volunteers: Rina->change-window policy, Carlos->metrics thresholds, Alex->bot PR template. Aim for a staging dry-run canary next sprint. :rocket:
